description: SessionStart injects the routing part once per context epoch (startup, resume, clear, compact): why the protocols exist — the Purpose section of skills/route/SKILL.md, carried as written — then the derived table, each protocol's deficit → resolution and the description it declares, so whether a protocol comes in is judged in the turn itself, with nothing invoking /route on its own; the premise index with every path absolute goes out as a second entry, each its own injection since the host caps each one's size — scripts/route-session.mjs. SubagentStart puts the same premise index into a subagent's own context before its first prompt, except a fork, which inherits it, and the routing part does not go — scripts/route-subagent.mjs. PreToolUse delivers a premise entry again at the tool call the matcher decides is its moment — scripts/route-tool.mjs. Only `description` and `hooks` go in this file: Codex rejects any other top-level key and then registers none of these hooks.
